text.what: The Vosne-Romanée domaine that owns Romanée-Conti and La Tâche outright and holds pieces of Richebourg, Échezeaux, Grands Échezeaux, Romanée-Saint-Vivant and Montrachet. Sold in mixed cases, allocated by relationship, and resold at multiples nobody at the domaine sets.
text.story: The Abbey of Saint-Vivant in Vosne held 1.8 hectares here from 1232. The prince de Conti bought the parcel in 1760; the Revolution sold it on; the Villaine and Leroy families have run the domaine through the twentieth century. Five hectares in La Tâche and Grands Échezeaux went biodynamic first, and the practice spread from there.

kin.as: Co-director, and the man who carried the Climats to UNESCO.
The region whose reputation this address both makes and distorts.

tags.note: no tasting room; the domaine does not receive the public
